details: Bitcoin whales have reportedly increased their holdings to 3.03 million BTC, marking the highest accumulation since November 2025. This move, coupled with a mysterious buyer transferring $97 million in BTC to new wallets, signals renewed institutional interest. Fidelity and Blackrock are leading a $176 million Bitcoin ETF rebound, indicating positive inflows into the asset.
title: Bitcoin Whales Accumulate, ETFs See Rebound

details: Bitcoin's price has remained flat, hovering around $83,500, with its recovery challenged by resistance at $84,000. Crypto investors are closely monitoring upcoming U.S. inflation data, which is anticipated to show a rise to 3.6%, as a key factor that could dictate Bitcoin's near-term price direction.
title: Bitcoin Price Stalls as Market Awaits US Inflation Data

details: South Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) has taken action to block 27 cryptocurrency exchange websites, including major platforms like KuCoin and MEXC. This regulatory move raises significant concerns for existing crypto users in the country regarding access to their accounts and the broader availability of digital asset services.
title: South Korea Blocks 27 Crypto Exchange Websites

details: Ripple has expanded its network, with its stablecoin RLUSD now gaining custody on the XRP Ledger through Standard Chartered. Additionally, Ripple has partnered with Stripe-owned Privy to integrate wallet technology into the XRP Ledger and secured a new deal with South Korea's Meritz Securities. These collaborations aim to enhance the utility and institutional adoption of XRP.
title: Ripple Secures New Partnerships for XRP Ledger and RLUSD

details: Interactive Brokers has initiated Ether staking services in collaboration with Zerohash. This development provides institutional clients with more accessible avenues to participate in Ethereum's proof-of-stake mechanism, potentially increasing institutional engagement and capital flow into the Ethereum ecosystem.
title: Interactive Brokers Launches Ether Staking with Zerohash
